purpose: Curated web directories and visual sources for design research; no entitlement to third-party assets

sites.name: DevLibraries
sites.use: Compare concepts, frameworks, previews and per-library licenses. Drill down to ORIGINAL maintainer before selecting donor; never treat aggregate site as one OSS repo.
sites.source_content_summary: Indexed UI library/component directory; counts are dynamic and not a guaranteed inventory.
notes: No copying of code/assets from directory until original author/source license confirmed
React/Next.js examples are design references, not ready-to-use Flutter implementations

sites.name: Ruixen UI
sites.use: Reuse source-pinned research already tracked by Design-App; React code is not directly Flutter ready.
sites.source_content_summary: Existing source catalog 277 TSX references and 41 curated candidates, prior audit.

sites.name: Gentleface
sites.use: See existing 28 reference icons and app matrix; no vendored asset without license gate.
sites.source_content_summary: Previously documented Gentleface animated icon source.

sites.name: beUI
sites.use: Original source of Voice Orb surfaced by DevLibraries. Reference-only for Flutter and Compose.
sites.source_content_summary: Public original library with web and React Native implementations.

sites.name: easeUI
sites.use: Refer to source-pinned public MIT component for animation design, not as a replacement for Theme M3 or Flutter code.
sites.license: MIT source in rjcuff/easeui; easeUI Pro separate

sites.name: Amicro
sites.use: Confirm executable source files and dependencies for each specific item; four current names are metadata-only.
sites.license: MIT source root in Subhan-code/Amicro--Micro-transitions-; asset-specific gate

sites.name: Watermelon UI
sites.license: MIT original platform repository; asset/dependency rights separate; no Flutter runtime verified
sites.use: Use component repo source as concept and integrate only after Product Bible and framework/QA gate; three exact names are unlocated.

sites.name: Dribbble
sites.use: Inspect exact shot URL and author, extract general UI patterns; build original Flutter/Compose components. Never copy screenshot/artwork/code without separately documented permission.
sites.source_content_summary: Four individually inspected public shots linked in research audit, plus mobile design discovery.

sites.name: Collect UI
sites.use: Use curated category pages as inspiration, verify individual post and source before precise attribution or reuse. Several categories are empty/dynamic.
sites.source_content_summary: Verified sign-up, scroll-animation, infographic categories and trending; no assumed author-specific asset license.

sites.name: Uiverse
sites.source_content_summary: 108 authenticated personal favorites (11 added since 97, none removed), 111 total Uiverse components and 111 originals archived: 57 Galaxy archive snapshots + 54 live Uiverse HTML/CSS pairs; 736 PROPOSED_ONLY mappings across 25 apps
sites.license: MIT official source; external assets independently verified

sites.name: Flutter Gems
sites.use: On-demand discovery only; check original pub.dev GitHub license/SDK/updates; Design-App user-curated aesthetics first.

sites.name: Forui
sites.use: Single-widget pilot only after Product Bible and Design-App; verify Flutter SDK and footprint before adding package.

sites.name: F22 Labs Flutter UI comparison
sites.use: Second-hand overview; actual article dated Aug 4 2026, compare original package maintainers.

sites.name: Material Design 3 — Google
sites.use: Optional design system ONLY when selected for the individual app. Never mandatory and never banned. User-curated Design-App references and Product Bible precede. Preserve existing M3 if coherent; do not port Flutter Golden code into Kotlin/Compose.
sites.source_content_summary: Google Material 3 portal is JS-rendered for direct text; official Flutter & Android developer documentation confirms color, typography, shapes, components, dynamic color and Material 3 Expressive. Source is a design system, not an external OSS code donor.

sites.name: Flutter Component Library
sites.use: Priority on-demand Flutter component discovery AFTER user-curated Design-App/product style and applicable Golden/donor. Copy source ONLY with exact source file, compatible license, dependencies/SDK and consumer QA evidence. Do not auto-install components.
sites.source_content_summary: 15 component pages show titles/demos/declared Dart paths; some list pub packages. Original Dart sources, source repo and site-wide commercial license were not verified from available page text.
